problems.quote: The reasoning section usually carries 30‑35 questions to be solved in 30‑35 minutes
problems.problem: Railway recruitment exams (RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, etc.) have a composite time limit (e.g., 90 minutes for 100 questions) with no separate sectional timing for reasoning; the 30‑35 minute figure is a suggested allocation, not a rule.
problems.correction: The reasoning section usually carries 30‑35 questions but has no separate time limit.
problems.verifierReason: RRB exams use composite timing; no sectional limit exists. Correction accurately removes false time limit.
